summary: MINISO Group Holding Ltd furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a Hong Kong next-day disclosure announcement) reporting on-market share repurchases of its HK-listed ordinary shares (stock code 09896), with buybacks intended for cancellation. Two lots totalling 104,960 shares (0.0086% of existing issued shares) were repurchased on October 8, 2026 at USD 2.2419 per share, with issued shares unchanged at 1,214,041,449. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or deal price is disclosed. The filing also references a voluntary business update. Watch for the pace and cumulative size of the buyback program and any authorized mandate limits.
